{{Quote|And Zekk. Who, may I ask, invited Zekk? He's not family.''"<br />"''Not yet.|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Mara Jade Skywalker]]|<ref name="Betrayal">''[[Legacy of the Force: Betrayal]]''</ref>}}
'''Zekk''' was a street-smart, [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] orphan from [[Ennth]] who befriended the Solo twins [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina]] and [[Darth Caedus|Jacen]]. After a fall to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] in his teenage years, he trained to be a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]. Zekk would later go on to participate in the offensives against the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] and [[Gorog|Dark Nest]]. During the [[Dark Nest Crisis]], he and Jaina became [[Joiner]]s and formed a particularly strong mental connection with one another.

As of [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]], Zekk and Jaina were un-Joined but still shared some thoughts. Soon after that they became partners, though Jaina's family thought they were romantically involved. During the [[Second Galactic Civil War]] he and Jaina participated in the [[Battle of Tralus (Second Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Tralus]] as part of the [[Hardpoint Squadron]]. Soon after, he participated in the [[Blockade of Corellia]] under the leadership of Jacen and Jaina. Zekk later joined forces with Jaina and [[Jagged Fel]] to hunt down the rogue Dark Jedi [[Alema Rar]]. Zekk mysteriously vanished from the Force during the war's [[Battle of Uroro Station|final battle]]. Jaina, who never felt him die, insisted he was still alive somewhere. He was considered missing in action, only to emerge months later alive, well, and romantically involved with the [[Hapan Security]] officer [[Taryn Zel]].

==Biography==
===Early life===
Zekk spent the first nine years of his life on the planet [[Ennth]], where his parents were colonists. When Ennth began to self-destruct, as it did every eight years, Zekk, a bright, promising child, was sent to one of the planet's crowded orbiting refugee stations for several months until Ennth was safe for habitation again. His parents, who intended to join him in orbit, stayed on the surface too long trying to retrieve the last of their possessions and were killed in a [[Groundquake/Legends|groundquake]].<ref name="YJK: SoA">''[[Young Jedi Knights: Shards of Alderaan]]''</ref>

Zekk, not wanting to stay on Ennth any longer without a family, escaped the refugee station and stowed away on a supply ship. For a period of time Zekk jumped from one ship to another, seeking out a life for himself, until he met the old spacer [[Peckhum]], who became his friend and took him in.<ref name="YJK: SoA" />

====Life on Coruscant====
{{Quote|You don't understand, Jacen. You can't because you've always ''had'' too much. You've never wanted for anything.|Zekk, to [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]]|<ref name="YJK: TLO" />}}
Peckhum and Zekk shared a mid-level apartment on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] that had been abandoned during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Zekk had a degree of freedom that most children didn't have, since Peckhum was often away running supplies in his beat-up freighter, the ''[[Lightning Rod]]'', or working as a caretaker for one of the many [[Orbital Solar Energy Transfer Satellite]]s that surrounded Coruscant.<ref name="YJK: TLO" />

Zekk would often leave the apartment to explore Coruscant's undercity, where he discovered that he had something of a talent for finding things that were valuable. This talent was hit-or-miss, though. On one occasion Zekk climbed down forty-two stories of an abandoned [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolift]] shaft to find that what seemed to be a glittering object was actually a piece of foil wrapping stuck to some ooze.<ref name="YJK: TLO" />

Zekk would give the valuable scraps of metal, trinkets, and lost objects that he found to Peckhum, who knew how to sell them and whom to sell them to in order to put food on the table. However, the things that Zekk found were collected faster than Peckhum could sell them and as a result, they accumulated inside their apartment.<ref name="YJK: TLO" />

Zekk's knowledge of Coruscant's undercity and his talent for finding things caught the eye of [[Norys]], the leader of a gang known as the [[Lost Ones]]. Though Norys derided Zekk as a "trash collector," he wanted Zekk to be his right-hand man so that he could access Zekk's vast knowledge of the streets of Coruscant's undercity. Zekk refused the offer because he didn't want to be the accessory of a bully like Norys. Norys didn't react well to the rejection, and while he decided that he wouldn't care if Zekk was maimed or killed, he still kept the invitation to join the Lost Ones open.<ref name="YJK: TLO" />

====Meeting the Solo kids====
{{Quote|Remember the fun we always had together, you and Jacen and I? Remember the time you salvaged that old slicer module and we tapped into the computers at the holographic zoo? We programmed all of the animals to sing Corellian tavern songs."''<br>''"We got caught. And the zoo restored the original programming."''<br>''"Yes, but so many returning tourists requested it that a few months later the zoo added our singing animals as a separate exhibit.|[[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] and Zekk|<ref name="YJK: JUS">''[[Young Jedi Knights: Jedi Under Siege]]''</ref>}}
[[File:YoungJediKnight_TERC.jpg|thumb|right|220px|Zekk and other members of his class at the Jedi Praxeum]]
Sometime around [[18 ABY/Legends|18 ABY]], Zekk met [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] and her brother [[Darth Caedus|Jacen]]. Though he was aware of&mdash;and somewhat resented&mdash;the fact that they were better off than himself, Zekk didn't allow that to keep him from becoming friends with the twins. Zekk and the twins, as well as their brother [[Anakin Solo|Anakin]], had many adventures together. Eventually Jacen and Jaina left for [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] [[Jedi Praxeum]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]], leaving Zekk behind on Coruscant.<ref name="JJK: AQ ">''[[Junior Jedi Knights: Anakin's Quest]]''</ref>

The Solo twins would later return to Coruscant with their friends [[Tenel Ka Djo|Tenel Ka]] and [[Lowbacca]] for a month-long vacation. On the first day that they were there, they joined Zekk for yet another adventure into the undercity of Coruscant, where they discovered an abandoned [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] and helped Zekk "acquire" a [[Hawk-bat/Legends|hawk-bat]] egg. After that, Zekk invited them to a midday meal of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] rations at his apartment. Jaina eventually suggested that in return, she and Jacen should invite him to a diplomatic dinner that would be held a couple of days later.<ref name="YJK: TLO" />

Zekk accepted the invitation and had Peckhum help him select some new clothes that would help him fit in at the banquet. Before Peckhum left once again to attend to his duties as the caretaker of an OSETS, Zekk promised the old man that he would find a [[central multitasking unit]] that would be needed to make the broken-down station more fit for [[Human/Legends|Human]] habitation. A day later, Zekk made his way to the [[Imperial Palace/Legends|Imperial Palace]] to attend the banquet.<ref name="YJK: TLO" />

At the moment that he met [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], the [[Solo family/Legends|Solos']] droid, Zekk's well-hidden resentment of the difference between his social status and that of his friends returned. The prissy droid stated that Zekk's "new" clothes were out of style and attempted to comb out the tangles in his long hair. The height of Zekk's embarrassment came at the banquet when Jaina pointed out to him that he had eaten a bouquet, which he had mistaken for a salad. Jaina's mother, [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]], not wishing for Zekk to be publicly embarrassed also had her family eat the bouquets.<ref name="YJK: TLO" />

After the diplomatic function was over, Zekk furiously left the Imperial Palace as quickly as possible. He was unaware at the time, however, that his gaffe had indirectly ''helped'' pave the way for a trade agreement and alliance between the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and the world of [[Karnak Alpha]], as the native ambassador, of a species that held children above all, had been impressed with Organa Solo's effort to make young Zekk more comfortable. On his way home, he came across [[Tamith Kai]], who was looking for Dark Jedi recruits for the Shadow Academy. She scanned him with a [[Force detector]], and, seeing that he had the potential to be a very strong [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], stunned and kidnapped him.<ref name="YJK: TLO" />

===Dark Jedi===
====Induction into the Shadow Academy====
{{Quote|You'll be scavenging for the rest of your years, selling trinkets to earn enough credits for your next meal. Do you really have any chance for power or glory or importance of your ''own''? I'm offering you that chance, boy. Are you brave enough to take it?|[[Brakiss]]|<ref name="YJK: TLO" />}}
Later, Zekk awoke in a cell aboard the [[Shadow Academy]]. His first visitor would be [[Brakiss]], the master of the Shadow Academy. He apologized to him for [[Tamith Kai]]'s "enthusiasm" and promised that he would be quartered in better lodgings. Brakiss then informed Zekk that the talents that he had used to survive in Coruscant's undercity were no small thing, for they were an unconscious manifestation of Zekk's [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitivity]]. And if the readings of Tamith Kai's Force detector were right, he was especially strong in the Force.<ref name="YJK: TLO" />

Brakiss then turned to the task of turning Zekk against his friends Jacen and Jaina. Among other things, Brakiss claimed that the twins knew of Zekk's power and consciously decided not to tell him about it. He also cast doubt upon Zekk's belief that his "friends" or anybody else would come seeking for him, given that he was merely a street youth.<ref name="YJK: TLO" />

Lastly, Brakiss made Zekk question his future. If he chose not to develop his powers, he would be allowed to leave the Shadow Academy and continue his existence as a trash collector and nothing more. Brakiss told Zekk that he would be giving up a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to make something of himself. After this, Brakiss left Zekk alone with his thoughts and a number of delicious pastries. True to Brakiss' promise, Zekk was eventually assigned better accommodations and given a uniform that he found to be dark and dashing.<ref name="YJK: TLO" />

====Darkest Knight====
{{Quote|I know this is something you wouldn't approve of, but I'm doing it for ''myself.'' If I ever come back, I'll be someone you can all be proud of.|Zekk's farewell message to his friends|<ref name="YJK: TLO" />}}
[[File:ZekkDarkestKnight.jpg|thumb|left|Zekk as the [[Darkest Knight]].]]
The next day, Brakiss brought Zekk to his office and showed him the power that he could wield if he trained at the Shadow Academy. Impressed that he indeed could use the Force, Zekk decided to do so at once. His first assignment on behalf of the Shadow Academy would be recruiting members of the Lost Ones to fill the ranks of the Second Imperium. Zekk would be accompanied to the headquarters of the Lost Ones by Tamith Kai, [[Garowyn]], and [[Vilas]] in order to ensure their cooperation, and possibly his as well.<ref name="YJK: TLO" />

As he recited his speech to a large group of unusually subdued members of the Lost Ones gang, Jacen and Tenel Ka stumbled upon the gathering. Despite Jacen's pleas to him to leave the Shadow Academy, Zekk refused to listen to him, not wanting to squander the opportunity to better himself. He looked on as Jacen and Tenel Ka were stunned and left unconscious on the floor. He left with the new recruits for the Shadow Academy.<ref name="YJK: TLO" />

Eventually, the Shadow Academy was forced to leave its hiding place near Coruscant, but Zekk managed to keep one last promise to an old friend. Defying his new teachers, he jettisoned a [[message pod]] that contained the central multitasking unit that he had promised to get for Peckhum. It also contained a message to his former friends. Zekk's hologram explained his reasons for choosing to train at the Shadow Academy.<ref name="YJK: TLO" />

Zekk progressed quickly in his training, so much so that Brakiss rewarded him with his own [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. After killing Tamith Kai's apprentice Vilas in a forced duel to the death to prove himself, he was the title "[[Darkest Knight]]" by a seemingly resurrected [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], making him in effect Brakiss' right-hand man.<ref name="Young Jedi Knights: Lightsabers">''[[Young Jedi Knights: Lightsabers]]''</ref>

Zekk then was chosen to lead [[Battle of Kashyyyk (Second Imperium Crisis)|an attack]] to [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], where the Second Imperium would gain important [[Computer/Legends|computer]] components for its fleet; Tamith Kai would accompany him, along with fellow [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] Garowyn and [[Vonnda Ra]]. However, when he had heard from that Solo twins were en route to the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] homeworld, he did his best not to show any reservations would have about fighting them. After [[Multispectrum disguise suite|infiltrating]] the [[Thikkiiana computer fabrication facility|computer center]] in [[Thikkiiana City/Legends|Thkkiiana City]], Zekk had a fabricated message sent to the [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] as a lure, for he knew Tamith Kai wanted to see if he could be trusted to strike down his old friends.<ref name="Young Jedi Knights: Darkest Knight">''[[Young Jedi Knights: Darkest Knight]]''</ref>

When the Imperial attack commenced, Jacen, Tenel Ka and Lowbacca arrived. Vonnda Ra tried to dispatch them with [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]], but Zekk intervened, claiming he wanted to the job in his own way. The Jedi escaped deep into the [[Shadowlands/Legends|Shadowlands]], and the Imperials gave chase. Then, Zekk [[Force sense/Legends|sensed]] Jaina nearby and ordered Vonnda Ra to continue the pursuit while he dealt with the only Solo daughter. He found Jaina along with an injured [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]]. After a brief bout of [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinetic]] sparring, Zekk warned her about the upcoming attack on the Jedi Praxeum and told her to stay away. Because of his feelings for her, he spared her life and withdrew.<ref name="Young Jedi Knights: Darkest Knight" />

Zekk's first mission was complete, but the Second Imperium had suffered losses, including Vonnda Ra and Garowyn. Even so, Brakiss was immensely pleased with his protege's success. While Zekk managed to fool his Master into believing that the Padawans were "no longer a problem", the suspicious and angry Tamith Kai was not convinced.<ref name="Young Jedi Knights: Darkest Knight" />

====End of the Shadow Academy====
{{Quote|There's no place where I belong anymore, Jaina. The Shadow Academy became my home. It's gone now&mdash;completely destroyed. Where can I go? The dark side is a part of me.|Zekk|<ref name="YJK: JUS" />}}
Zekk then led the [[Third Battle of Yavin|assault]] on the Jedi Praxeum on Yavin 4. He proved that he was not completely a Dark Jedi when he refrained from killing [[Raynar Thul]], instead humiliating him in front of other Dark Jedi that were with him so that they would not consider it worth the effort to kill Thull. Most of his Dark Jedi were killed, as was Tamith Kai. Zekk watched as the ''Lightning Rod'' was pursued by a [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighter]] and regretted putting Peckham in danger. When the fight on the ground was done, he caught sight of the Shadow Academy's destruction above the planet's surface, taking Brakiss along with it. In a last-ditch effort, he walked to the [[Great Temple/Legends|Great Temple]], where he had a confrontation with former friend Jaina Solo. She tried her hardest to turn him back to the light, but Zekk refused her efforts, although he did refrain from killing her. After his duel with Jaina, he warned the students to stay away from the Temple, or everyone would die. Shortly thereafter, a bomb inside the Temple went off. Zekk was not as lost as it appeared, for he had saved everyone by keeping them away from the impending explosion. During the explosion, a shard of rock hit Zekk in the head, knocking him out.<ref name="YJK: JUS" /> Jaina and the others cared for Zekk until he recovered from his injury.<ref name="YJK: TEP">''[[Young Jedi Knights: The Emperor's Plague]]''</ref>

===Bounty hunter===
{{Quote|I don't let a paycheck decide between right and wrong for me.|Zekk, to Ailyn Vel|<ref name="YJK: TEP" />}}
[[File:Jk-zekk.gif|200px|thumb|Zekk during his short career as a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]].]]
After recovering, Zekk was asked to stay at the Academy and train as a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], but he refused, fearing he'd fall to the dark side again. Trying to decide what to do next, Zekk returned to Ennth, his homeworld, arriving during one of its destructive cycles. Zekk used the ''Lightning Rod'', which Peckhum had given to him as a going-away present, to help evacuate as many colonists as possible, but soon realized that Ennth was no longer where he belonged. After saving his friends from [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]]&mdash;actually [[Ailyn Vel]] in disguise&mdash;in the [[The Graveyard|ruins]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], Zekk decided to learn how to become a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]], believing that his Force abilities would enable him to become one of the best hunters available. More importantly, it would help him track down Raynar Thul's missing father [[Bornan Thul|Bornan]].<ref name="YJK: SoA" />

Zekk's first assignment was an associate of Thul's named [[Fonterrat]], who owed a shipment of [[ronik shell]]s to [[Droq'l]], the bartender of [[Shanko's Hive]] on [[Borgo Prime/Legends|Borgo Prime]]. Fonterrat's last known location was [[Gammalin]], but when Zekk arrived there, all he could find thus far the devastation brought upon the [[Human/Legends|human]] population. He had been incapacitated by Ailyn Vel, who was on the hunt for Thul. After explaining his assignment, Zekk was released and discovered Fonterrat's remains in a holding cell. Records and the rodent-like [[Scavenger/Legends|scavenger]]'s [[Holocube/Legends|holocube]] revealed that his employer, [[Nolaa Tarkona]], had snuck a [[Emperor's Plague|plague]] aboard his ship, causing him to unwittingly infect the humans on Gammalin. Ailyn then left to resume the search for her quarry, allowing Zekk to deliver the holocube as proof of Fonterrat's demise.<ref name="YJK: DV">''[[Young Jedi Knights: Diversity Alliance]]''</ref>

Zekk was hired by a disguised Bornan Thul to find his brother [[Tyko Thul|Tyko]], who was apprehended by [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droids]], as well as send a message to the [[Bornaryn Trading Fleet]]. Once he transmitted the message on [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]], however, he was ambushed by and narrowly escaped by [[Dengar/Legends|Dengar]]. Zekk tracked Ailyn down to [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] and, in exchange for information about Dengar, asked her about proper business conduct while working bounties. Upon learning from Jaina that [[IG-88A/Legends|IG-88A]] was responsible for Tyko's abduction, he went over the scene of the battle on [[Kuar]] and, after further consultation with Bornan, tracked the notorious [[Droid/Legends|droid]] bounty hunter to [[Mechis III/Legends|Mechis III]].<ref name="YJK: DOG">''[[Young Jedi Knights: Delusions of Grandeur]]''</ref>

It was revealed that Tyko only appeared to be abducted so as to force Bornan out of hiding; Zekk discovered this the hard way, having suffered a singed arm from Tyko's defenses. Once he shared what he knew about Bornan, [[Nolaa Tarkona]] and her dangerous [[Diversity Alliance]] with Tyko, Raynar, the Solo twins and Tenel Ka, Dengar struck again. Zekk and Jaina used the ''Lightning Rod'' to lure the ''[[Punishing One/Legends|Punishing One]]'' away from the others, but it didn't work. Once the reprogrammed IG-88A disarmed Dengar, the [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] had to withdraw. Zekk was able to find the [[limpet mine]] that Dengar planted to track him back on Ziost and put it into a [[message pod]]; that way, Dengar would be sent in the wrong direction. Then he and IG-88 went their separate ways to resume the search for Bornan.<ref name="YJK: DOG" />

After a few weeks, Zekk found Bornan again, only to also find that Dengar had discovered his trick and was pummeling the [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]]'s ship. Dengar claimed the bounty for himself, but Zekk decided to rescue Bornan, breaking the [[Bounty Hunter Code|Code]]. Bornan remained suspicious of Zekk in spite of this, forcing the latter man to place a [[Homing beacon/Legends|homing beacon]] concealed in a [[Torpedo/Legends|torpedo]] on the former's ship, having learned the trick from Dengar. By the time Ailyn appeared on the scene, Bornan had launched into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]. Zekk did the same in order to escape the combined lethal outrage of the veteran hunters.<ref name="YJK: JB">''[[Young Jedi Knights: Jedi Bounty]]''</ref>

Contemplating the connection between the plague on Gammalin and the [[Navigation computer/Legends|navicomputer]] that belonged to Fonterrat, Zekk decided to visit Yavin 4 and ask Raynar to convince his father to trust him. But Luke Skywalker informed him that all of his friends were on a mission to either [[Hapes/Legends|Hapes]] or [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]], and together, they foiled the attempted murder of Padawan [[Lusa]] by a Diversity Alliance agent. As distrust between Lusa and Zekk grew with regards to each other's pasts, Luke convinced them to use the Force to [[Force empathy/Legends|probe each other's feelings]] for the truth; Zekk reluctantly did so, for he feared returning to the dark side. Lusa revealed that the Solo twins, Raynar and Tenal Ka had actually gone to [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] to rescue Lowbacca and his sister [[Sirrakuk]] from the Diverity Alliance. All three decided to mount an extrication mission themselves. Once Jaina and Raynar were safely aboard the ''Lightning Rod'', Zekk took over the weapons systems and let Luke fly the ship to Coruscant, the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]]'s renowned piloting skills impressing the young man.<ref name="YJK: JB" />

Zekk assisted Lusa with the nutrient monitors on their friends' [[Bacta tank/Legends|bacta tanks]], and once they were all healed, he and Raynar left to find Bornan; the [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] lord would be able to trust Zekk more if his son could talk him into it. They managed to rescue Bornan from Ailyn and another bounty hunter named [[Shakra]], only for Ailyn to hack into Bornan's ship records before it self-destructed and send the location of an Imperial [[Emperor's plague storehouse|bioweapon facility]] to Nolaa Tarkona. She would have destroyed the ''Lightning Rod'' if not for the arrival of the Solo twins, Lowbacca and Tenel Ka aboard the ''Rock Dragon''; Zekk had insisted that Jaina stay out of it for her own protection, but she went after him anyway.<ref name="YJK: TEP" />

Together, the friends and Bornan went to the storehouse to destroy the human-killing plague that even Palpatine dared not use. But the Diversity Alliance, led by Tarkona, was not far behind, and they managed to [[Battle of the Emperor's Plague Storehouse|complicate things]]. When Tarkona found the plague in the central chamber, Bornan went in alone to stop her at the cost of his life. Zekk, Lowbacca, Raynar and [[Translator droid/Legends|translator droid]] [[M-TD]] were assaulted by Diversity Alliance soldiers but were saved by Ailyn, who had been hired by Tyko to rescue Raynar and Bornan no sooner after finishing her contract with Tarkona. Disturbed by Ailyn's ice-cold professionalism, Zekk realized that he had too much of a conscience to be a bounty hunter, and he finally had enough faith in himself to be trained as a Jedi.<ref name="YJK: TEP" />

===Black Sun===
Following the Diversity Alliance conflict, Zekk would return to the academy to train as a true Jedi. His initial attempts proved difficult, so Luke Skywalker suggested he start using the Force in ways that felt familiar to him. Zekk would go on to participate in&mdash;and win&mdash;the [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] [[Blockade Runners Derby]]. There, the young Jedi and his friends would encounter [[Anja Gallandro]] and be pulled into the rise of a new [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] crime syndicate. Zekk, seeing anger untamed in Anja, sympathized with the girl and,<ref name="YJK:RTOM">''[[Young Jedi Knights: Return to Ord Mantell]]''</ref> along with Jacen, spent a great deal of time trying to help her, much to Jaina's dismay.

Zekk would finally go on to construct a new [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] with a flame-colored blade.<ref name="yjkccr1">''[[Young Jedi Knights: Crisis at Crystal Reef]]''</ref> He would later use it to help his friends defeat Black Sun and escape an underwater glacier on [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]]. After this mission, he and the other young Jedi Knights were promoted to apprentice Jedi Knights in a ceremony at the [[Jedi Praxeum]], and Zekk finally accepted the mantle of a Jedi.

===The Yuuzhan Vong War===
{{Quote|No. Vengeance leads to the dark side, I won't be a part of something like that.|Zekk|<ref name="SbS">''[[The New Jedi Order: Star by Star]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Zekk.png|left|thumb|Zekk during the Yuuzhan Vong War]]
During the opening months of the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] invasion, Zekk acted as a forward observer for the Jedi in monitoring the invasion path. He also assisted in several planetary evacuations and refugee relocations sponsored by [[Senate Select Committee for Refugees|SELCORE]].<ref name="SbS" />

Two years into the conflict, Zekk was chosen as one of the members of the [[Myrkr strike team]] sent to destroy the [[voxyn]] queen. This reunited him with Jaina, whom he still had romantic feelings for, but Jaina revealed to him that she thought of him as a brother, not a potential lover. He flew under the callsign "Bounty Hunter."<ref name="SbS" />

During the mission, the team rescued two Dark Jedi, [[Welk]] and [[Lomi Plo]], but Zekk was instantly wary of them given his past history with the Shadow Academy and his own experiences as a dark Jedi. His fears were proven right when the two stole the ''[[Tachyon Flier]]'', a ship that was to be used to extract the strike team. [[Raynar Thul]], injured and badly needing medical attention, was still aboard during the hijacking. With the mission in shambles, the remaining members made a risky attempt to recover Anakin's body. With Anakin's body in tow, Zekk and the others stole a Yuuzhan Vong frigate and forged their escape from the Yuuzhan Vong worldship, under heavy fire from their pursuers. With Raynar, [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]], and [[Anakin Solo]] dead or missing, Zekk watched as his best friend, Jaina Solo, started to turn to the dark side.<ref name="SbS" /> Zekk feared that if he tried to bring her back, he would just fall with her, and he knew that he would never be able to kill her if she truly fell, so he gave her some distance.<ref name="DJ">''[[The New Jedi Order: Dark Journey]]''</ref>

Zekk was present on [[Hapes/Legends|Hapes]] for Anakin Solo's funeral.<ref name="DJ" /> Zekk later accompanied the other Myrkr survivors to [[Borleias/Legends|Borleias]], where he participated in the [[Battle of Borleias (Yuuzhan Vong War; Second)|battle]] there.<ref name="el2rs">''[[The New Jedi Order: Enemy Lines II: Rebel Stand]]''</ref>

Four years into the war, Zekk officially became a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] in a ceremony on [[Dac/Legends|Mon Calamari]]. He then joined Jaina, [[Tesar Sebatyne]], Lowbacca, [[Tahiri Veila]], and Jacen in participating as [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] pilots for the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] against the Yuuzhan Vong, with fleet action culminating above [[Ebaq 9]].<ref name="dw1">''[[The New Jedi Order: Destiny's Way]]''</ref>

Zekk was one of many Jedi who bonded with seed partners on [[Zonama Sekot/Legends|Zonama Sekot]] at the [[Battle of Yuuzhan'tar]], where he helped defend the living planet from [[Nas Choka]] and [[Alpha Red]].<ref name="tuf1">''[[The New Jedi Order: The Unifying Force]]''</ref>

===Dark Nest Crisis===
{{Quote|Our boyfriend means business.|Zekk, to Jaina Solo about [[Jagged Fel]]|<ref name="tjk1" />}}
In [[35 ABY/Legends|35 ABY]], Zekk was one of the Jedi involved in the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] border dispute. He had abandoned his post to join other Myrkr survivors in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]], where they discovered Raynar was still alive and leading a colony of [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]]. Due to the amount of time spent around the Killiks, he eventually became a [[Joiner]] along with Jaina. The two shared an extremely close mental bond, resulting in the awkward situation of sharing not only thoughts but also feelings, as Zekk was forced to experience Jaina's romantic feelings for [[Jagged Fel]], just as she was forced to experience Zekk's romantic feelings for her. Despite its awkwardness, the Joiner bond caused Zekk and Jaina to grow closer to one another.<ref name="tjk1" />

The two Joiners, along with the Killiks and Tenel Ka's [[Hapan]] fleet, helped defend [[Qoribu]] from the Chiss. Zekk and Jaina then helped track down pirates that were smuggling black [[Membrosia/Legends|membrosia]] just before the Swarm War started. Their actions during the [[Skirmish at Qoribu|skirmish]] led them to be expelled from the Taat Nest.<ref name="tjk1" />

A year later, Zekk and Jaina were assigned to investigate reports of stolen [[Tibanna/Legends|Tibanna]] gas on [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]]. Upon their arrival at [[BesGas Three]], the two intercepted three [[Tibanna tapper]]s using [[siphoning balloon]]s to siphon gas and pursued them into the planet's high atmospheric zones. After the thieves were taken into custody, it was learned that the stolen Tibanna gas was being stolen by Joiners for use in the Killik military buildup. Zekk, Jacen, Jaina, Tesar, Tahiri, and Lowbacca were later tricked by Jacen into attacking a Chiss base, believing that they were the enemy.<ref name="The Unseen Queen">''[[Dark Nest II: The Unseen Queen]]''</ref>

When Luke Skywalker called all the Jedi to [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]], Zekk and Jaina ignored the call, choosing to remain on Tenupe and help the Killiks win the [[Battle of Tenupe|battle]] there. They were forced to work with the Jedi traitor [[Alema Rar]] to destroy the Chiss' weapon against the Killiks, parasites. During the battle, Zekk led airborne squadrons of Qeeq and Aebea, providing aerial support to the ground forces of Jooj and Rekker, led by Jaina. Zekk and Jaina engaged Jag in a dogfight, but Jag ejected before he could be shot down. At the end of the [[Swarm War]], Zekk and Jaina were rescued by the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] from the shelter they were holed up in on Tenupe. As the war came to its conclusion, both of them were recovering in the infirmary, and were quite worried about Jagged Fel's fate.<ref name="The Swarm War">''[[Dark Nest III: The Swarm War]]''</ref> Shortly afterwards, Jaina and Zekk decided to go through a reconditioning process under Jedi Master [[Cilghal]].

===Second Galactic Civil War===
====The War begins====
[[File:Zekkscard.jpg|thumb|right|240px|Jedi Knight Zekk]]
Zekk and Jaina were later un-Joined, though not completely; in [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]] both still shared a close bond, and still shared some thoughts. Both&mdash;especially Jaina&mdash;denied their relationship as being anything more than one of friends and partners, but Jaina's family saw something more than a simple friendship. They both were part of the strike force sent to capture [[Five World Prime Minister|Prime Minister]] [[Aidel Saxan]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] with [[Kolir Hu'lya]] and [[Thann Mithric]]. Here they encountered a trap where Zekk suffered burns on his leg and back as a result from a explosion and was only saved due to the combined efforts of Kolir and Jaina. They later fought together at the [[Battle of Tralus (Second Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Tralus]] commanding the [[Hardpoint Squadron]].<ref name="Betrayal" />

Sometime after the Battle of Tralus, which initiated a [[Second Galactic Civil War|new galactic war]], Zekk and Jaina joined [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]], with Jaina as its leader. Jacen Solo was commissioned as a [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] to lead the [[Galactic Alliance Guard]]. During the [[Blockade of Corellia]], Jacen became the new Rogue leader. This upset Zekk and Jaina. Zekk watched as Jacen aggressively handled the situation, and feared that Jacen had turned to the dark side.<ref name="Bloodlines">''[[Legacy of the Force: Bloodlines]]''</ref>

====Intrigue on Hapes====
After Jaina's suspension, both Zekk and Jaina ceased operations for the military, instead serving the Jedi Order, which included a reconnaissance mission to the [[Kiris Asteroid Cluster]], where they detected the ''Millennium Falcon''{{'s}} jump towards Hapes.<ref name="Bloodlines" />

Shortly after their scouting missions, Zekk shared a revelation he had with Jaina: he and Jaina truly were better friends than they would ever be lovers, a fact Jaina had tried to convince him of for years. Ironically, this caused her to treat him with more respect and possibly even attraction. Later, Zekk and Jaina were assigned to investigate [[Ducha]] [[AlGray]]'s estate, but it turned out to be a trap. The Ducha, however, had joined the Hapan insurrection and sent [[YVH 1]] droids after them. Narrowly escaping, Zekk and Jaina were eventually rescued by [[Ben Skywalker]], who had been sent by Jacen to rescue them. Upon arriving near Hapes with the valuable intelligence, Zekk, Jaina, Ben and another crewman fled in the escape pods as the skiff came under attack by insurrection forces.<ref name="Tempest">''[[Legacy of the Force: Tempest]]''</ref>

Rescued by the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], Zekk and the others boarded the ship under heavy fire from the [[Anakin Solo (starship)|''Anakin Solo'']], by order of Jacen. As Han helped them aboard, Ben tried to arrest Han, but Zekk prevented him from doing so. Seeing the severe extent of the damage, Zekk helped patch the ''Falcon'' together, but as he was doing so, Ben again tried to take Han into custody and force him to surrender to the Galactic Alliance, even going so far as to pull his lightsaber on Jaina. Seeing this, Zekk came up behind Ben, restraining him, but Ben turned and slashed Zekk's side with his saber.<ref name="Tempest" />

Zekk, severely injured, jettisoned in the ''Falcon''{{'s}} escape pods along with Jaina, Ben, and the other crewman; all were later rescued by Hapan vessels. On Hapes, Zekk was taken to the infirmary for surgery, but was expected to survive the injury.<ref name="Tempest" />

====The Hunt for Alema Rar====
[[File:Jainazekk_newec.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Zekk and Jaina Solo]]
Zekk later teamed up with Jaina and [[Jagged Fel]] to hunt down [[Alema Rar]]. During the mission, Jagged admitted to both Zekk and Jaina that he was jealous of Zekk, and that it was this jealousy, and not any lack of skill on Zekk's part, that had led Jag to keep Zekk out of Jaina's Twin Suns Squadron during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. Despite the marked rivalry between Zekk and Jag over the other's supposed interest in Jaina, Zekk and crew nearly nabbed Alema aboard the ''[[Errant Venture/Legends|Errant Venture]]'' before she managed to escape on the ''[[Duracrud]]''.<ref name="Exile">''[[Legacy of the Force: Exile]]''</ref>

After her escape, Zekk, Jag and Jaina followed Alema to [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]], where they found her abandoned vessel in the forest treetops. After an initial disagreement between Zekk and Jag over who would accompany Jaina to the [[Jedi Academy (Ossus)|academy]] to guard the [[Youngling/Legends|younglings]], Zekk agreed to stay behind and watch Alema's ship. Upon arriving, Jaina and Jag discovered that Major [[Salle Serpa]] had taken the Academy hostage on Jacen's orders, and Jaina warned Zekk to stay hidden in the forest. When Serpa stopped Jaina's offensive by holding one of the children, [[Vekki]], at blasterpoint, Zekk emerged from the trees in a surprise attack, cutting off Serpa's arms and saving Jaina and the younglings.<ref name="Inferno">''[[Legacy of the Force: Inferno]]''</ref>

After encountering Alema Rar's [[Force phantom]] aboard the ''[[Love Commander]]'', Zekk, Jaina and Jag tracked her to [[Lumiya]]'s asteroid habitat. While there, Zekk was injured by one of Alema's phantoms; soon after, he and Jaina were [[Skirmish at The Home|attacked]] by Ship, Alema's [[Sith Meditation Sphere]]. Zekk realized that he could talk to Ship using the dark side techniques he'd learned at the [[Shadow Academy]], and chose to make the sacrifice of once again touching the dark side to save Jaina's life. Buying time for Jaina to escape, Zekk successfully convinced Ship to leave Alema Rar and the asteroid. However, with his defenses now compromised, Zekk was overcome by the dark side energy of the asteroid, making it impossible for him to escape. Jaina found Zekk, dazed and emotionally wounded, and managed to get him out of danger, leaving Jag behind on the asteroid, where he found and killed Alema Rar. Though still traumatized, Zekk began to recover when he was away from the dark side energy present on the asteroid.<ref name="Fury">''[[Legacy of the Force: Fury]]''</ref>

====Taking on Caedus====
Zekk remained at the Jedi base on [[Shedu Maad]], recovering from his brush with the dark side, eventually gathering strength enough to spar with Jaina. Zekk was present for the arrival of Ben and [[Tenel Ka Djo]], accompanied by the Queen Mother's cousins, [[Trista Zel]] and her identical twin [[Taryn Zel|Taryn]], who immediately took a liking to the "handsome" Zekk.<ref name="Invincible">''[[Legacy of the Force: Invincible]]''</ref>

During the pre-launch preparations for the Jedi attack on the ''Anakin Solo'', Zekk was oblivious to the thoughts of Jaina as she reflected on their relationship, which had grown more distant while she had been with the Mandalorians. During the actual [[Battle of Uroro Station|battle]], Jaina and Zekk drew the ''Anakin Solo''{{'s}} fire long enough for the Hapan fleet to arrive. With their ships heavily damaged, Zekk disappeared during their last and most dangerous pass on the ''Anakin Solo''. He was no longer present in the Force, but Jaina had not felt him die. After the death of Caedus, Jaina ordered a search to begin for Zekk.<ref name="Invincible" /> He reappeared six months later, romantically involved with Taryn Zel and refusing to speak about where he had been, leading Han and Leia Solo to speculate he had gone on a secret mission for Tenel Ka.<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Backlash">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Backlash]]''</ref>

===Back in action===
Zekk reemerged from his absence during a period of turmoil for the Order: the Galactic Alliance citizens were becoming increasingly hostile to the Jedi, Chief of State Natasi Daala was determined to bring the Order under control, and Luke had been exiled. Zekk came back to lend his aid, and was also romantically involved with Taryn Zel.

==Personality and traits==
Having grown up as an orphan, Zekk became very independent. As such, he constantly had only his own skills to rely on, scavenging what he could and finding his way first around the galaxy, then through the lower levels of Coruscant, unaware he was being aided by his affinity with the Force. This talent allowed him to find valuable items others could not and even meet people such as the Solo twins that would change his destiny. Zekk was a loyal friend and had an unusual sense of humor; he was the only one who laughed at Jacen Solo's jokes. In spite of this, he was bitter over growing up without parents and living without the luxuries that were afforded to his friends.<ref name="YJK: TLO" />

Seduced by the promises of a better life, Zekk became a pupil at the Shadow Academy<ref name="YJK: TLO" /> where he was a keen learner. He became the best apprentice of the academy after he beat his rival Vilas.<ref name="Young Jedi Knights: Lightsabers" /> After being redeemed, he sought his own way in life and became a bounty hunter, though he ultimately turned away from that way of life after realizing how amoral that way of life was.<ref name="Young Jedi Knights: Delusions of Grandeur">''[[Young Jedi Knights: Delusions of Grandeur]]''</ref><ref name="Young Jedi Knights:Jedi Bounty">''[[Young Jedi Knights: Jedi Bounty]]''</ref> When he became a Jedi he was absolutely against acts of revenge and would attempt to point out the flaws of such actions to his friends.<ref name="SbS" />

==Powers and abilities==
{{Quote|Apparently, he has the potential. Remember, Uncle Luke found lots of candidates who never knew they could use the Force. Zakk had a knack for finding things to salvage, even in places where other people have scavenged already.|Jacen to Jaina Solo, on Zekk after his induction into the Shadow Academy|<ref name="YJK: TLO" />}}
{{Expandsect}}

==Behind the scenes==
With the release of ''[[Legacy of the Force: Betrayal]]'', Zekk's age was called into question. Previous sources all state that he is about two years older than Jaina, but ''Betrayal'' states he is a few years younger. This has been stated by ''Betrayal'' author [[Aaron Allston]] to be a continuity error, and that the older age is correct.<ref name="allstonblog">{{Blog|aaron_allston|1|Launching the blog&hellip;}}</ref>
